name: Pokémon Parallel Emerald
summary: Pokémon Parallel Emerald is a reimagining of the Hoenn region, with all maps having been redesigned, expanded, or completely reworked. Gym Leaders, Rivals, Elite Four Members and more have also been changed with Pokémon and battle mechanics up to the 8th Generation. Parallel Emerald is playable with three difficulty modes, and a sandbox mode.
